inputs.text: SSANU has given the federal government one month to renegotiate the 2009 agreement or face an indefinite nationwide strike. Government should take its obligations seriously and pursue a fair settlement—but threatening to shut down universities is a blunt weapon that puts students and families in the middle. Workers have rights, but so do the people who depend on universities to function. Both sides should show discipline, negotiate in good faith, and keep public education from becoming collateral in a labor dispute.
